messages:
Ellen (release-lead): quick heads-up: compact cutover tonight 01:00-01:15 UTC. API/runtime/console/router all in the tiny window. please ack and call out any hard blockers.
Raj (runtime): ack. runtime plan: pin model-serving image to rti:v2.3.1-rc2 for the window. will hold autoscale at min=3 to avoid cold starts.
Kim (router): ack. router will accept header-swap + gradual traffic ramp: 0->10->30->100 over 10m. will pin header-version to v4-compat. need rollout hold if p50 latency > 120ms.
Sam (console): console ops noted. UI will show the pinned variant and will disable manual model switch during the window. release notes will include the pinned versions and rollback steps.
Jen (product): quick ask — include the user-facing blurb in release notes: "improves runtime stability for long contexts". small wording tweak?
Ellen (release-lead): yep, add that. also we need an agreed rollback trigger set: 5% error rate increase OR sustained 3-minute spike in tail latency. Kevin, you good to be oncall for rollback go/no-go?
Kevin (oncall): I can monitor. set me as primary pager. If deploy-bot posts automatic rollback, I'll confirm within 3 minutes.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: service=runtime, variant=rti:v2.3.1-rc2, canary_pct=10, window=5m. cc @Ellen (release-lead)
Raj (runtime): testing scripts posted in #eng-releases. smoke commands:
```
curl -H 'x-variant: rti-v2.3.1-rc2' https://api.redwood-inference.internal/health
kubectl logs -n runtime -l app=rti -c runtime --since=10m | tail -n 200
```
Kim (router): routing snippet for the opsrun:
```
routerctl set-weight runtime-v4-compat 10 --from runtime-stable && sleep 120 && routerctl set-weight runtime-v4-compat 30
```
Sam (console): release-notes checklist: 1) pinned runtime image, 2) router header flag, 3) console UI lock, 4) canary metric dashboard link, 5) rollback playbook (included). I'll push a draft in 10m.
Ellen (release-lead): decision points: preflight green -> canary 10%. after 5m and metrics ok -> ramp 30%. after 10m and no regressions -> full rollout. rollback immediate if error_rate +5% or p99 > 800ms for 2 consecutive minutes.
Raj (runtime): noted. I will also disable experimental quant path for the window to reduce variance.
Kim (router): will hold on the 30% ramp if router CPU increases by >15% on any node.
Kevin (oncall): monitoring dashboards: runtime/latency, runtime/errors, router/cpu, console/500s. I set alerts for the rollback thresholds.
Jen (product): minor: please add a short note for sales about the brief UI lock so CS doesn't get surprised.
Ellen (release-lead): good call. Sam can you add that to release notes and ping #customer-success?
Sam (console): done. drafted note and pinging CS once we start the canary.
deploy-bot: canary started: runtime rti:v2.3.1-rc2 at 10% (ts=1776543305). Monitoring hooks active.
Raj (runtime): smoke looks good from my side. avg token throughput stable.
Kim (router): router CPU stable at +3%. no anomalies.
Kevin (oncall): no alert fires. p50=55ms, p95=210ms, errors +0.2%. green for ramp to 30%.
Ellen (release-lead): proceeding to 30% ramp now. Kim will execute set-weight. hold 10m then eval for full rollout.
Kim (router): started ramp to 30%. executing command.
Raj (runtime): I'm watching logs for KV cache pressure; nothing unusual.
deploy-bot: ramp complete: 30% at ts=1776543420.
Kevin (oncall): small p95 blip to 340ms for 1m then back down. no sustained issue. still green.
Jen (product): CS pinged and acknowledged. release notes sent to the mailing list.
Ellen (release-lead): if all stays green at end of window we will roll to 100% and unpin for normal rollout policies after 30m observation. final decision at 01:13 UTC.
Sam (console): adding final unpin step to the runbook: `post-rollout: unpin image tag & re-enable console switching`
Raj (runtime): ready for full rollout on my mark.
Kevin (oncall): watch party until 01:25 UTC but will only trigger rollback if thresholds hit.
deploy-bot: full rollout initiated: set runtime variant -> rti:v2.3.1-rc2 -> 100% (ts=1776543595).
Ellen (release-lead): thanks team. rolling notes: runtime pinned during window, console locked, router header set to v4-compat. follow-up: postmortem only if we see >1% customer-facing errors in next 24h.
Kim (router): reverting the header flag is ready if needed. runbook in place.
Sam (console): releasing console lock in 30m and updating docs.
Jen (product): copying final notes into the product changelog.
Kevin (oncall): no rollback needed. monitoring remains nominal.
Ellen (release-lead): excellent. I'll close the window and write the short post-deploy summary in #eng-releases in 15m. :tada:
